name: error-loop
title_zh: Sentry报错直接变PR，先写失败测试再修
tagline_zh: 线上报错别再手动翻日志。它从干净分支复现，每个issue对应一个PR，复现不了就自动开needs-info。
tagline_en: Stop digging logs manually. It reproduces from clean master, one PR per issue, or files needs-info when.
desc_en: Turn unresolved Sentry issues into pull requests - reproduce with a failing test at the seam, fix, open one PR per Sentry issue, or file a needs-info issue when it cannot be reproduced - "/error-loop", "run the Error Loop", "fix the production errors". Run on demand from a clean checkout of a Project's master; a session may also launch it as a subagent.
why_zh: 机制上卡在“接缝处”写失败测试，确保修复有据可依；每个Sentry issue独立成PR，不混改。
why_en: It pins the fix with a failing test at the seam, keeps each PR atomic per issue, and forces honest triage when reproduction fails.
limit_zh: 需要项目已有Sentry集成且能本地跑测试；只处理可复现的报错，若环境依赖复杂或需外部服务。
limit_en: Requires Sentry integration and runnable tests. Only handles reproducible errors; complex env or external deps lead to a needs-info issue.
title_en: Turn Sentry errors into PRs with a failing test first
